prompt: After Edward II, who was the next English monarch to have been born outside of England?
answer: **Richard II** was the next English monarch after Edward II to be born outside England. He was born at **Bordeaux, in the Duchy of Gascony (France), on 6 January 1367**. Edward III, who reigned between them, was born at Windsor in England.
